headlines.description: Arsenal recorded a first Premier League win at Anfield in 14 years but needed some help from Liverpool goalkeeper Alisson Becker, whose first-half error led to Kai Havertz's solitary goal in the 1-0 win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Arsenal hold off Liverpool for first win at Anfield since 2012

headlines.description: Thierno Barry's second-half strike helped Everton return to winning ways in the Premier League with a 1-0 victory over Newcastle at St James' Park.
headlines.shortLinkText: Barry leads Everton to second win over Newcastle in four days

headlines.description: Thierno Barry's hot streak fired Everton into the top five as they came from behind to beat Coventry 3-1.
headlines.shortLinkText: Barry's brace propels Everton up to 5th with win over Coventry

headlines.description: Noah Okafor stepped off the bench to snatch Leeds three points as they beat Tottenham 1-0 at Elland Road to snap their five-game winless Premier League run.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tottenham's winning run brought to abrupt end by late Leeds strike

headlines.description: Arsenal needed a captain's goal from Martin Ødegaard to see off Hull 1-0 and ensure they head into the international break with a healthy lead at the top of the Premier League.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ødegaard scores winner as Arsenal scrape past Hull to extend PL lead

headlines.description: Jacob Murphy's wonderful late strike was not enough to earn Newcastle victory at Craven Cottage, with Rodrigo Muniz levelling minutes later to earn Fulham a deserved 1-1 draw.
headlines.shortLinkText: Late Muniz equaliser sees pressure on Jaissle and Newcastle grow

headlines.description: Liam Delap's emphatic brace earned Nottingham Forest a first home win of the season and piled the misery on Manchester City with a 3-1 victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: City slip to third straight loss as Delap inspires Forest

headlines.description: Diego Gómez scored another stunner as Brighton enjoyed a happy homecoming by climbing to second in the Premier League with a 2-0 win over 10-man Brentford at the Amex Stadium.
headlines.shortLinkText: Title challengers? In-form Brighton see off Brentford to go second

headlines.description: Florian Wirtz scored his first Premier League goal of the season as Liverpool beat struggling Crystal Palace 3-1 at Selhurst Park.
headlines.shortLinkText: Isak, Wirtz-inspired Liverpool return to winning ways vs. poor Palace

headlines.description: Another Evanilson goal helped fire Marco Rose's Bournemouth to an eighth straight victory with a hard-fought 2-1 win at Ipswich.
headlines.shortLinkText: Evanlison fires Bournemouth past Ipswich for eighth straight win

headlines.description: Sunderland ended their winless run in the Premier League with a hard-fought 1-0 win over Chelsea at the Stadium of Light.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alonso's Chelsea fall to defeat at PL strugglers Sunderland

headlines.description: Two goals down inside four minutes against Aston Villa in the Premier League on Sunday and trailing 4-2 going into second-half added time, Manchester United rallied to a 4-4 draw on another night of mayhem and drama at Old Trafford.
headlines.shortLinkText: Man United twice come from two goals down to salvage point against Aston Villa

events.name: Brighton & Hove Albion at Hull City
Newcastle United at Brighton & Hove Albion
